title: 第3章 空间气泡恐吓第4章 能量点数粉色梦境
slug: 虚实梦境之主从死后开始
content_zh:
孟天紧了紧手中方向盘，突然咧嘴一笑，本就用力踩着油门的脚，再次用力猛蹬。
“桀桀桀桀，冲冲冲，冲啊，呦吼...”
孟天摇晃着身体癫狂大笑，发泄着心中的狂躁怨气。
看着前方走到路中心的熟悉身影，以及对面进行倒计时的红灯，孟天丝毫没有停下的意思，直接就是一冲而过。
“噗嗤！”
车过处，只留下一片炸开的“番茄酱”。
孟天继续油门到底，极速向前行驶。
哪怕到了道路的尽头，他也丝毫没有松开油门的打算。
就在他撞上空间屏障的瞬间，面前突然一阵扭曲。
等其再次回过神来的时候，已经重新出现在了右侧的道路尽头。
向前行驶，便是那一个红绿灯。
“重开了嘛...”
孟天低语。
发泄了一番，孟天内心舒缓了许多，不再那么狂躁。
回想着刚才，似乎相比先前，增长的力量提升了一倍。
孟天眼神微闪，当即顺势脚踩油门，再一次的狂冲向前。
再次轮回之后，一直细细感应的孟天，也终于是确定了，他所提升的力量确实增长了一倍。
微微思索，孟天收回司机身上的念头。
一次轮回过后，力量增长重新降到正常水平。
在又进行几次测试之后，孟天终于确定，不只是他的死亡会增加力量，他主导死亡的发生，同样也会增强他的力量。

回想死亡空间的存在根本以及死亡规则，孟天若有所思。
遵循死亡空间的死亡规则，他的力量就会增加。
他死亡增加力量，由他实施死亡同样增加力量，如此提升的力量，自然增加了一倍。
而且...
孟天看着自己走向路中间的分身，眸光一阵闪烁。
下一刻，他的一点念头融入司机体内，又将分身收回，转而调动死亡空间的力量，凝聚出了一个虚拟人。
压路机过处，虚拟能量体化作一摊肉泥。
“嗡~！”
刹那之间，虚拟人的死亡处，空间剧烈的扭曲起来，并且迅速向着周围扩散。
“卧槽，停下，给我停下，给我，镇！”
看着扭曲的空间，孟天忍不住的惊呼出声，瞬间调动死亡空间的力量，竭尽所能的镇压扭曲空间，好半天方才重新稳住了空间稳定。
经过这次的试验，孟天确定了先前的部分猜测。
比如他驾驶压路机撞死他人，同样能够获得力量的增长。
只不过，因为他没有参与死亡，所以并不会获得死亡的那份力量。
并且，因为空间的根本是他死亡。
因此，如果他没有被压死的话，空间就会崩溃。
哪怕有着虚拟人的替代，空间也会剧烈动荡，需要消耗远超提升的力量去镇压修复，完全就是得不偿失。
对于这一情况，孟天有着两种猜测。
一种就是他的死亡不可替代；
另外就是虚拟人毕竟是虚假的存在，所以并不能代替他。
content_en:
Meng Tian tightened his grip on the steering wheel, suddenly grinned, and stepped hard on the accelerator again.
"Jiejiejiejiejie, rush, rush, rush, yo ho..."
Meng Tian shook his body and laughed maniacally, venting the manic resentment in his heart.
Looking at the familiar figure walking to the center of the road ahead and the red light with countdown on the opposite side, Meng Tian showed no intention of stopping and just rushed past.
"Pfft!"
Wherever the car passed, there was only an explosion of "ketchup" left behind.
Meng Tian continued to accelerator to the end and drove forward at high speed.
Even when he reached the end of the road, he had no intention of letting go of the accelerator.
The moment he hit the space barrier, there was a sudden distortion in front of him.
When he came to his senses again, he had reappeared at the end of the road on the right.
Drive forward and you will see the traffic light.
"It's reopened..."
Meng Tian whispered.
After venting, Meng Tian felt much relieved and no longer so manic.
Thinking back to just now, it seems that the power of growth has doubled compared to before.
Meng Tian's eyes flashed slightly, and he immediately stepped on the accelerator and rushed forward again.
After another reincarnation, Meng Tian, ​​who had been sensing carefully, was finally sure that his enhanced power had indeed doubled.
After thinking for a moment, Meng Tian retracted his thoughts about the driver.
After one reincarnation, strength growth drops back to normal levels.
After conducting several more tests, Meng Tian finally determined that not only would his death increase his strength, but his leading the death would also increase his strength.
Meng Tian thought thoughtfully as he recalled the fundamental existence of death space and the rules of death.
Follow Dead Space's rules of death and his power will increase.
His death increases his strength, and his death also increases his strength. The strength thus increased is naturally doubled.
And...
Meng Tian looked at his clone walking towards the middle of the road, his eyes flickering.
The next moment, some of his thoughts merged into the driver's body, and he took back the clone, and then mobilized the power of the dead space to condense a virtual person.
Wherever the steamroller passed, the virtual energy body turned into a puddle of meat.
"Buzz~!"
In an instant, the space where the virtual person died was violently distorted and spread rapidly to the surroundings.
"Fuck, stop, stop, give me, Zhen!"
Looking at the distorted space, Meng Tian couldn't help but exclaimed. He instantly mobilized the power of the dead space and tried his best to suppress the distorted space. It took a long time to stabilize the space again.
After this experiment, Meng Tian confirmed some of his previous guesses.
For example, if he kills others by driving a roller, he will also gain strength.
However, because he did not participate in death, he would not gain the power of death.
And, because the root of space is his death.
Therefore, if he had not been crushed, space would have collapsed.
Even if there is a virtual human replacement, the space will be violently turbulent, and it will take far more power to suppress and repair than the improvement, which is completely outweighing the gain.
Meng Tian had two guesses about this situation.
One is that his death is irreplaceable;
In addition, the virtual person is a false existence after all, so it cannot replace him.
